messages:
liam: Emergency alert — sudden rise in 502/504s from eu-west1 for requests >8k tokens. Repro on staging. Root looks like tokenizer loop and spike in allocator leading to OOM. Building emergency patch 2.3.6-patch (sha_d4e5f6). Need fast-track canary approvals to reduce time-to-fix.
release-bot: Automated prechecks: tests OK, infra checks OK, canary quota available. Incident created: #INC-623.
tina: Can watch the rollout. Request we pin rollback to last-known-good 2.3.4 (sha8f9) and pre-create a rollback job. Also need clear failure triggers.
liam: Proposed rollout: 1% -> 10% after 3m -> 50% after 3m -> 100%. Requesting to shorten windows to 3m each and permit skipping final staged wait if metrics stable. Rollback triggers: absolute 5xx >0.5% or p95 increases by >300ms vs baseline for 3m window.
marco: SRE ack. Will set aggressive alerts and standby rb job rb-1003. Approve expedited canary if ops are watching.
de bbie: CS note: flag this EU-only and include CS contact. Also request customer-facing blurb draft after deploy.
release-bot: Command queued: /deploy canary 2.3.6-patch --pin=sha_d4e5f6 --canary-windows=3m,3m,3m --stages=1,10,50,100 --region=eu-west1
liam: Executing now. Please :eyes: if you can watch logs.
release-bot: Deploy started by liam at 1970012345. Link: https://deploys.redwood/1970012345
ops-oncall: :eyes: watching logs. No immediate errors in first 60s.
marco: metrics look healthy at 1% for first 90s. p95 380ms, 5xx 0.03%.
qa-bot: Triggering long-prompt regression suite on canary instances. Test set: 25 examples >8k tokens.
release-bot: Canary promoted to 10% at +3m
marco: small uptick in p95 to 470ms but within threshold. Continuing.
qa-bot: 25/25 long-prompt tests passed on canary.
release-bot: Canary promoted to 50% at +6m
liam: Noting: keep rollback job ready. If any user-facing errors spike, roll back immediately.
marco: Observability: setting tempo window to 2m for p95 alerts. No anomalies at 50%.
de bbie: Drafting release note: 2.3.6-patch fixes tokenizer OOM for long prompts in eu-west1. Will send to CS after final.
release-bot: Canary to 100% at +9m initiated
marco: Still green at 100%. p95 baseline ~420ms, 5xx ~0.04%. No customer reports.
ops-oncall: Traffic normalized and error rates returned to baseline.
qa-bot: Post-deploy regression suite re-run on a sample of 100 long prompts: pass rate 100%.
liam: Closing deploy. Follow-ups: add tokenizer regression to mandatory CI on PRs and schedule postmortem in 48h.
release-bot: Deployment complete at +12m. Deployment id 1970012345. Incident #INC-623 -> mitigated. Postmortem required within 48h.
debbie: I'll coordinate CS messaging and add change note to release page. Thanks all.
marco: Great job team. Leaving rollback job in standby for 2 hours.
liam: Thread closed, moving to monitoring.
